source_caption_text:
Will forever be funny 😂

Did you knoe Adam Sandler shows up at the very end of Nelly’s “Errtime” video.

The song dropped March 15, 2005 off The Longest Yard soundtrack. Nelly, Jung Tru, and King Jacob. Produced by Jazze Pha. It was the main record tied to the remake that had Nelly, Chris Rock, and Sandler in the same movie.

It peaked at No. 24 on the Billboard Hot 100, No. 59 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop, No. 27 on the Pop 100. Went Gold in the U.S. Charted overseas too , No. 15 in Australia, No. 21 in New Zealand.

The video already had Snoop Dogg in it and scenes from the film, including D12. Then after the song wraps, Sandler comes in for the last seconds. No verse. Just the cameo.
That’s the clip people keep circulating. 
Soundtrack single. Movie promo. Sandler last.
